title: Add interactive decision row approval and planning-impact preview
summary: Improve the decision loop UX so users can approve/edit/reject/defer wiki_diff_table rows in a structured Pi TUI table and see a read-only planning-impact preview without merging decision and planning compilers.

goal.outcome: Decision rows are presented as a user-actionable TUI table backed by wiki_diff_table, with a provisional planning-impact preview that does not mutate roadmap truth.
acceptance: Pi TUI decision approval surface shows structured row fields, status, risk, alternatives, proof refs, and approve/edit/reject/defer controls or explicit fallback instructions.
Actions call the existing wiki_diff_table contract and persist row-level user action evidence.
Decision UI includes a read-only planning-impact preview that identifies likely knowledge-only, task, sprint, or deferred outcomes and invalidates when rows change.
Planning preview does not call wiki_roadmap or mutate roadmap truth.
Smoke tests or equivalent cover rendering/action model and fallback behavior.
non_goals: Do not merge decision and planning compilers.
Do not create roadmap tasks from the decision UI.
Do not require a full terminal diagram renderer in this task.
verification: targeted smoke tests for decision approval/planning preview
wiki_audit source-contract or changed profiles as applicable
